correctness.rationale: The exact radial moment integral, integration by parts and positivity of mollifier moments give eigenvalues 0 below m, 1 at m, and a nonnegative trace tail bounded by exp(2epsilon)-1. Alternating finite sums approximate c_j J P_{<N_j} in S1; the resultant Sp bound is summable for each p>1. Gaussian separation proves q_m convergence, domain admissibility, and heat-peak isolation. The critical-heat value is exactly 2j times the Laplace mean of rho_epsilon, at least 2j exp(-2epsilon); other translated blocks contribute less than 2^{-j-4}, leaving a peak >3j/2. Virtanen Theorem 1.1(i) excludes S1. The 186 finite exact rational tests are supplementary, not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The general all-p>1 existence assertion of Virtanen Theorem 1.1(ii) is acknowledged as known. The distinct theorem gives one fully specified real C-infinity symbol with deterministic separated supports, quantitative heat blowup, and explicit radial trace-norm approximants. Looi proves operator-norm compactness-type bounds for different Weyl blocks, not simultaneous all p>1 Schatten estimates in the inspected sections. Garcia and Maximenko give constructive uniform approximations but not this trace-norm/heat construction. Publication priority is not independently certified.
